content.comment_body: We have been using an Insys IMON-G300 for several years, but with the planned shutdown of 3G services in January 2022, it will no longer work for us. Are others facing the same issue? If yes, have you found or planned any replacement hardware, as Insys has discontinued the IMON-Gx00 series and does not provide a 4G-compatible alternative? I am interested in suggestions for suitable replacements. Thanks. Split from topic regarding Insys IMON-G100 monitoring a [product_name] [article_no] over LAN.

Hello, I am currently using RUT240 as a substitute for IMON routers. It is affordable and runs reliably on the latest firmware. The main drawback is that an external server and a custom monitoring app are required. M.
